title: Kuramba Pakati Pezvakawanda
intro: Unozviwana uri pakati pevanhu vane misika yakazara nekutengeserana, asi zviyero zvavo zvinodonha zvisina kururama. Nhume yasvika kwavari nenyevero dzakajeka, asi vanoseka vobva vadzokera shure, vachivimba nekubudirira kwavo. Denga rinotanga kusviba, asi vanoona sechikomborero chemvura. Vanhu ava ndivanaani?
clues: Takabudirira munyika dzekutengeserana nedzekudya zvakawanda, asi mwoyo yedu yakava yakaoma.
Mutumwa akauya kwatiri nezviratidzo kubva kuna Ishe wedu, asi takaseka yambiro dzake.
Taizivikanwa nebasa redu, asi taipa nguva pfupi uye taibiridzira vanhu.
Taigara pakati pemiti mikobvu nemiti yakasvibira, asi taisatora makomborero edu seasina basa.
Gore dema parakasvika, takafara, tichifunga kuti raizounza mvura kunyika dzedu dzakaoma.
Asi, gore iroro rakaburitsa chirango chinopisa, uye takabatwa nekurwadziwa kwezuva remumvuri.

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko
options: Vakaramba mutumwa wavo uye vakabiridzira mukutengeserana
Vakavaka shongwe refu uye vakaedza Mwari
Vakaramba kugovera mvura uye vakakuvadza ngamera hadzi
trial.answer: Vakaramba mutumwa wavo uye vakabiridzira mukutengeserana

verse: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway. (15:79)
